assets.name: T_QuestFrame_Navy
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE empty portrait navy background panel for a production Unreal UMG quest index. Attached screenshot is style reference; reproduce ONLY the solid LEFT NAVY SURFACE's subtle material and vertical gold boundary treatment, with ALL existing UI and artwork removed. Portrait canvas about 3:5, very high resolution. One clean rectangular panel occupies 94 percent of canvas width and height, with narrow truly transparent RGBA outer margin. Opaque rich blue navy surface, visibly blue not black, approximately #132f49, subtly brighter in center #1b3c56. Extremely low contrast geometric/cartographic angular tonal pattern confined to the outer corners, center quiet and uninterrupted for runtime widgets. Right edge has TWO closely spaced straight, fine champagne-gold vertical lines, one slightly brighter, from top to bottom; left edge has ONE much fainter straight warm gold hairline. No horizontal gold border at top or bottom. Exact straight vertical edges, sharp rectangular silhouette and square corners. Panel alpha fully opaque to every edge, antialiasing only at the boundary; transparent outside. No fuzzy feathering, NO soft edge fade, NO haze, NO fog, no bloom or glow, no shadow block. No compass, no diamonds, no timeline, no horizontal internal lines, no text, no icons, no buttons, no list items, no foliage, no screenshot or environment. Independent empty background texture only.

No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no icons, no compass, no illustrations, no buttons, no internal dividers, no tabs, no complete UI, no background scene. Straight frontal flat UI art.
